ordering_strategy: Critical domains first (IAM, ONB, INV, SET, ADMIN, AUD, INT), then remaining gaps

sequence_overrides.rule: BL-AUD-001 must be delivered before BL-SET-* and BL-ADMIN-*
sequence_overrides.rationale: Standardized audit coverage is required before sensitive workflows

sequence_overrides.rule: BL-IAM-001 and BL-IAM-003 must be delivered before onboarding and commitment work
BL-INT-001 and BL-ONB-003 must be delivered before BL-DD-* and BL-INV-* where eligibility gates are required
sequence_overrides.rationale: Eligibility and compliance checks gate protected flows

sequence_overrides.rule: BL-SET-001 must be delivered before BL-SET-002 and BL-SET-003
sequence_overrides.rationale: Canonical funding references are prerequisite for reconciliation and exceptions

sequence_overrides.rule: BL-ADMIN-003 must be delivered before BL-ADMIN-001, BL-ADMIN-002, and BL-ADMIN-004
sequence_overrides.rationale: Governance controls must precede expanded admin tooling
